description: This file defines a servlet filter for the Spark History Server to redirect YARN proxy requests to the main SHS address, handling proxy-user cookies and performing client-side redirects.

classes.name: YarnProxyRedirectFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter for redirecting YARN proxy requests to the Spark History Server address.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration, currently empty.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, checks for proxy-user cookie, and performs redirect if present.

methods.name: doRedirect
methods.description: Performs a client-side redirect by writing an HTML page with a meta refresh.
